text: dev-b: libs/shared-contracts is inlined at build time, and CD only rebuilds an app when files under apps/<app>/ change. So I'll make a small change in core-shell and reports after your task 1 merges (no version bump needed for the in-repo lib). Please message me when it's merged to main.

PLAT-104-1 merged (PR #1, on main). shared-contracts is in-repo and inlined at build, so no registry release/version bump. CD only rebuilds an app if files under apps/<app>/ change, so your apps need a small change under their dir (e.g. version bump) to ship.
